## Pembaruan Utama Sabit v1.1.0 -- HILAL-DETECT V2 Dual-Model AI

### Integrasi Dual-Model YOLOv8 ONNX
- **Model Utama `YOLOv8s` (`Primary - Recommended`)**: Resolusi input `640x640`, confidence default `0.30`, dan NMS IoU `0.45` (`models/hilal/yolov8s/hilal_yolov8s_640.onnx`) untuk sensitivitas tinggi pada sabit tipis.
- **Model Alternatif Ringan `YOLOv8n` (`Lightweight Alternative`)**: Resolusi `640x640`, confidence default `0.75`, dan NMS IoU `0.45` (`models/hilal/yolov8n/best.onnx`) untuk latensi CPU lebih rendah.
- **Pergantian Model Real-Time Tanpa Restart**: Pilih model langsung dari toolbar utama; Sabit otomatis memuat bobot ONNX, memperbarui threshold confidence & NMS, serta menampilkan telemetri model aktif tanpa menggandakan sesi ONNX Runtime.

### Kontrak Inferensi & Validasi
- **Pipeline Pre/Postprocessing Sesuai Kontrak**: Letterbox RGB `[1, 3, 640, 640]` float32 NCHW (`pad=114`, normalisasi `/ 255`), dekode output `[1, 5, 8400]`, NMS di sisi C++ host, dan restorasi koordinat presisi ke resolusi asli kamera.
- **Paritas Teruji**: Validasi CPU `ONNX Runtime v1.17.1` cocok presisi dengan referensi training (`diff <= 1.2e-7` pada sample `expected_output.json`) serta dukungan probing aman `CUDAExecutionProvider`.

## Sabit v1.1.0 Highlights -- HILAL-DETECT V2 Dual-Model AI

### Dual-Model YOLOv8 ONNX Integration
- **Primary Model `YOLOv8s` (`Primary - Recommended`)**: `640x640` input, default confidence `0.30`, NMS IoU `0.45` (`models/hilal/yolov8s/hilal_yolov8s_640.onnx`) tuned for sensitive young crescent detection.
- **Lightweight Alternative `YOLOv8n` (`Lightweight Alternative`)**: `640x640` input, default confidence `0.75`, NMS IoU `0.45` (`models/hilal/yolov8n/best.onnx`) for faster CPU inference.
- **Runtime Model Switching Without Restart**: Switch models directly from the main toolbar; Sabit updates the ONNX session, confidence/NMS thresholds, and telemetry cleanly without duplicate session loads.

### Contract-Exact Inference & Validation
- **Exact Preprocessing & Postprocessing**: Aspect-preserving `640x640` RGB letterbox (`pad=114`, `/ 255.0` float32 NCHW), `[1, 5, 8400]` decoding, host C++ NMS, and inverse-letterbox bounding-box restoration.
- **Validated Parity & Hardware Readiness**: Verified C++ CPU parity (`diff <= 1.2e-7` against `expected_output.json`) with safe optional `CUDAExecutionProvider` probing and fallback.
